comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
SECOND AND THIRD OCCURRENCE IN ONE HOUR — 2026-08-13, both on the macos-latest py3.13 shard only, every ubuntu shard green.

- Gerrit **1715** (event_append split; confined to `src/rebar/_store/`) — GHA run 31680986340.
- Gerrit **1716** (rich-text conflict-safety pins for story `disparaged-parodistic-shrew`; TESTS-ONLY, one new file under `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/`) — GHA run 31681638153.

Both failed on the SAME single assertion:
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_removal_confirmation_a4bd.py::test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count`, at
`assert any("declined 1 inbound link removal" in m for m in messages)`. In both runs the captured records held the PER-LINK decline line (`_apply_inbound_update: declining the inbound removal of blocks link …`) but NOT the pass-summary line the assertion wants.

Why this is diagnostic rather than just another sighting: the two changes share no files, no lane and no author session, and 1716 cannot reach the assertion at all — it adds test code only. Two disjoint changes producing one identical macOS-only capture miss inside the same hour is positive evidence that the trigger is the shard's log-capture behaviour under xdist, not anything either change did.

The narrower signature also holds in both: it is the SUMMARY record that goes missing while the per-link record survives. If a fix is attempted, that asymmetry is the lead — the summary is emitted later in the pass, so the plausible mechanism is capture being torn down (or the handler swapped) between the two emissions on a worker, rather than records being dropped wholesale.

Both changes were rechecked on this basis.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Another occurrence, plus what looks like the exact root cause and a one-line fix already proven in a sibling file.

**Occurrence.** Hit on change 1715 (ticket statuesque-glycemic-iguana, a pure `src/rebar/_store/` module split that touches no reconciler and no test): CI `Verified -1`, macOS shard only, ubuntu shards green, single failing test `test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count`. Also reproduced LOCALLY on that tree under the same invocation (`-n 3 --dist worksteal`): 1 failed, 12699 passed. That makes at least three independent changes now red-lit by it (this one, `unheedful-custodial-bluebottle`, and the original report).

**Mechanism, confirmed from the captured records.** The assertion failure prints the caplog contents, and they contain the PER-LINK decline message but not the pass SUMMARY. Those two differ only in level:
- per-link decline -> `logger.warning` (`apply_inbound_records`, the "declining the inbound removal of ..." record)
- pass summary -> `logger.info` (the "declined %d inbound link removal(s)" record the assertion greps for)

So the record is being dropped AT THE ORIGINATING LOGGER, not at the handler — the signature of a leaked `setLevel(WARNING)` above INFO on `rebar_reconciler.apply_inbound_records`. Under xdist that leak only matters when the poisoning test happens to land on the same worker ahead of this one, which is exactly why it is intermittent and shard-dependent.

**The fix is already in the repo, in the sibling file.** `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_link_removal_2b16.py` hit this before (bug 9ac2) and defends against it:

    # Pin the level ON THE ORIGINATING LOGGER: it lives outside the `rebar` hierarchy
    # that tests/conftest.py's propagation guard restores, so a leaked
    # setLevel(WARNING) from an earlier full-suite test would otherwise drop this
    # INFO record at the source and make the assertion below unreachable (bug 9ac2).
    with caplog.at_level("INFO", logger=apply_records.logger.name):

`test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count` in `test_inbound_removal_confirmation_a4bd.py` still uses the bare form, `with caplog.at_level(logging.INFO):`, which raises only the ROOT level and leaves a leaked level on the originating logger in place. Changing it to the `logger=apply_records.logger.name` form should close this deterministically, matching the precedent 9ac2 already set.

Worth checking the rest of the a4bd file for the same bare form while fixing — and note `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py` deliberately exercises `logging.getLogger("rebar").setLevel(logging.WARNING)` as a "leaks today" scenario, so a poisoner of this shape demonstrably exists in the suite.

Not fixing it here — this is a different ticket and I hold statuesque-glycemic-iguana, not this one. Filing the analysis so whoever claims this can go straight to the change.

comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Control experiment confirms this is fully independent of any change under review.

Ran the exact CI invocation in a worktree at pristine `origin/main` @6f37d9495b with its own venv (verified `rebar` imported from that tree). Result: **1 failed, 12691 passed** — `test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count`, the identical single failure, on untouched main.

So the reproduction does not need a patch under review at all; it just needs the poisoning test to land ahead of the victim on the same xdist worker. Combined with the mechanism in my previous comment (INFO summary dropped at the originating logger while the WARNING per-link record survives) and the 9ac2 precedent fix already applied in the sibling 2b16 file, the one-line change to `caplog.at_level("INFO", logger=apply_records.logger.name)` should close it deterministically.

## Problem
tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_inbound_removal_confirmation_a4bd.py::test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under CI's parallel invocation (-n 3 --dist worksteal) as a log-capture flake, while passing 10/10 in isolation. Observed 2026-08-13 during an unrelated change's pre-push suite (the gitutil write-retry landing, ticket unheedful-custodial-bluebottle).

## Premise / suspicion
The test was added by the inbound-removal-discrimination work (epic a4bd S3, change 1705). Likely cause: caplog/propagation racing with sibling workers or a logger configured at import time in another worker's module set. Needs root-causing, not blind retry-marking.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Root cause recorded on this ticket (why capture misses the record under xdist).
- [ ] The test passes reliably under CI's exact parallel invocation (demonstrated by repeated -n 3 runs).
- [ ] No production logging behavior change (test-side fix only unless a real prod defect is found — escalate if so).
